from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
phase = sys.argv[1]
def git(*args):

for command in [['rustup', 'run', '1.90.0', 'rustc', '-V'], ['cargo', '+1.90.0', '-V']]:
    print(subprocess.check_output(command, text=True).strip())
oracle = Path('evidence/mobile-stage23/perf-investigation/ORACLE_PREIMAGE.json')
candidate = Path('/workspace/sg-stage23/home-summary/CANDIDATE_PREIMAGE.json')
preserved = Path('/workspace/sg-stage23/migration-safety/preserved-candidate')
for label,manifest,n,root in [('oracle',oracle,10,Path('.')), ('preserved',candidate,9,preserved), ('working-candidate',candidate,9,Path('.'))]:
    raw = manifest.read_bytes()
    print(label, 'manifest', str(manifest), hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    entries = json.loads(raw)['files']
    assert len(entries) == n
    changed = []
    for entry in entries:
        path=entry['file']
        data=(root/path).read_bytes()
        digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        same=(len(data),digest)==(entry['bytes'],entry['sha256'])
        print('MATCH' if same else 'CHANGED',len(data),digest,path)
        if not same:
            changed.append(path)
    if phase == 'start' or label != 'working-candidate':
        assert not changed, changed
    print(f'{label} {n-len(changed)}/{n} matched')
assert not git('ls-files','--','src-tauri/gen')
print('src-tauri/gen tracked files: 0')
if phase == 'end':
    expected = {'core/src/fault.rs', 'core/src/migration.rs', 'core/src/migration/tests/faults.rs', 'evidence/mobile-stage23/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md'}
    assert set(changed) == expected, changed
    fixtures = json.loads(Path('evidence/mobile-stage23/migration-safety/preimage.json').read_bytes())['fixtures']
    assert len(fixtures) == 15
    for entry in fixtures:
        data=Path(entry['file']).read_bytes()
        digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        assert (len(data),digest)==(entry['bytes'],entry['sha256'])
        print('ARCHIVE',len(data),digest,entry['file'])
    print('15/15 archived v3/v5 fixture files match their prior manifest')
    test_path = Path('core/src/migration/tests/faults.rs')
    tests = test_path.read_bytes()
    def without(src,begin,end):
        return src[:src.index(begin)] + src[src.index(end):]
    existing = without(tests,b'fn recover_after_failed_confirmation(',b'#[test]\nfn verified_commit_receipt_')
    existing = without(existing,b'#[test]\nfn witness_io_faults_',b'#[test]\nfn conflicting_intents_')
    assert existing == (preserved/test_path).read_bytes()
    print('All pre-M1 fault tests byte-identical after excluding the two added source blocks')
    safety = Path('evidence/mobile-stage23/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md')
    pointer = [line for line in safety.read_bytes().splitlines() if b'(M1_COMMIT_WINDOW.md)' in line]
    assert len(pointer)==1 and safety.read_bytes().replace(pointer[0]+b'\n\n',b'')==(preserved/safety).read_bytes()
    print('Prior migration safety report byte-identical after excluding the M1 pointer')
    subprocess.run(['rustfmt','+1.90.0','--edition','2021','--config','skip_children=true','--check',*sorted(p for p in expected if p.endswith('.rs'))],check=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
    assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
    print('Changed Rust source passes rustfmt; git diff --check passes; index has no staged files')
    evidence = Path('evidence/mobile-stage23/m1-commit-window')
    results = {'01-red':(1,4), '02-green':(5,0), '03-candidate-default':(6,0), '04-candidate-fault':(20,0), '05-native-oracle':(4,0), '06-legacy-migration':(1,0)}
    import re
    for line in (evidence/'commands.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
        row=json.loads(line)
        raw=(evidence/row['log']).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
        run=row['run']
        assert row['exit']==(101 if run=='01-red' else 0)
        if run in results:
            counts=re.search(rb'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed;',raw)
            assert counts and tuple(map(int,counts.groups()))==results.pop(run)
    assert not results
    print('All prior ledger log hashes, exits and test counts verified')
    report = Path('evidence/mobile-stage23/M1_COMMIT_WINDOW.md')
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', report.read_text()):
        assert (report.parent/target.split('#',1)[0]).is_file(),target
    print('Report links resolve')
    for name in sorted(expected | {str(report)} | {str(p) for p in evidence.iterdir()}):
        print('M1 FILE',name)
